name: io.github.faxforagents/faxforagents-mcp
description: Send and receive faxes from an AI agent: exact quotes, human approvals, delivery evidence, sandbox.

environmentVariables.name: FAXFORAGENTS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Fax for Agents API key (ffa_test_... for the sandbox, ffa_live_... for the carrier). Created at https://app.faxforagents.com. The server starts without it and every tool then explains how to get one.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer ffa_test_... or ffa_live_..., your Fax for Agents API key. initialize and tools/list work without it; calling a tool needs it.
